visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans across several light green 'UG UNI GREEN' branded paper bags and white plastic cups with matching floral patterns on a white kitchen counter. The bags feature a trio of people on the front. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the scene. (2) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a black sweatshirt, stands behind the kitchen counter. She waves both hands energetically at the camera and smiles. Behind her is a modern kitchen with a stainless steel stove and dark cabinets. (3) A man wearing a dark blue baseball cap and a black t-shirt with white 'MILK FED.' text sits at the counter. He holds a white cup with a straw, taking a sip and looking thoughtfully at the camera. (4) Close-up shots focus on the receipts pasted on the cups, detailing drink orders in Chinese characters. The background remains the clean, white kitchen countertop and the previously seen green bags. (5) The man continues his review, holding the cup and gesturing with his free hand. He points to the receipt on the cup. The lighting is consistent, casting soft shadows on his face and the objects. (6) A final close-up shows the man's face as he laughs heartily, his mouth open and teeth visible. He leans toward the lens, creating a sense of intimacy and humor.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A man's energetic voice introduces the popular UG drinks over a medium-tempo acoustic guitar BGM with a bright, uplifting tone. A subtle 'pop' sound effect punctuates the transition. (2) A woman's high-pitched, enthusiastic voice enters with a loud 'Hooray!' followed by the sharp, percussive sound of clapping. The music continues consistently in the background with a steady rhythm. (3) The acoustic guitar BGM swells slightly as the man speaks at a moderate pace, detailing his three-hour wait. The ambient room tone is quiet, suggesting a controlled indoor recording environment. (4) A distinct plastic rustle sound occurs as a straw is handled, followed by a wet slurping noise as the man takes a sip. His vocal tone becomes more analytical and contemplative as he reviews the taste. (5) The man's voice maintains a friendly, conversational tone while the acoustic music provides a warm melodic layer. The sound of a plastic spoon clicking against the rim of a cup is heard. (6) Multiple voices overlap in a lighthearted exchange about relationship metaphors and tea. The audio ends with a high-arousal, loud laughter from both the man and the woman, echoing slightly in the kitchen space.
